source.label: Outrights NFL Win Totals board
source.update_note: The publisher says books are polled every few minutes, but the rendered board does not expose a per-quote update timestamp. Capture time is authoritative for this snapshot.

official_crosscheck.label: BetMGM 2026 NFL win totals table
official_crosscheck.use: Pairing and sign-format cross-check only; its older prices are not mixed into the captured consensus.

methodology.probability: American odds are converted to raw implied probabilities; each same-book Over/Under pair is normalized proportionally to remove two-way hold.
methodology.consensus: At each threshold, the median of independently de-vigged same-book probabilities is used. Prices are never paired across books.
methodology.monotonicity: Observed tail probabilities are audited in threshold order and repaired only when necessary with weighted non-increasing isotonic regression. Point weights reward more paired books and lower-hold quotes.
methodology.order_index: For ordinal ranking only, index = posted half-win line + no-vig Over probability - 0.5. It stays within one-half win of the posted line and is not an expected-win estimate.
methodology.expectation: Expected wins are reported only with all 17 P(W >= k) tails observed. Sparse boards show an observed 50% bound/bracket and no expected-win value.
